title: The Gunslinger Born
creator: Peter David, Robin Furth & Jae Lee
description: The first Marvel Dark Tower graphic novel, dramatizing young Roland Deschain's trial by combat in Gilead and his doomed romance with Susan Delgado.
relation_note: Adapts backstory from Wizard and Glass into comics form - scripted by Robin Furth (King's own research assistant) and Peter David, not by King himself.

title: Long Road Home
creator: Peter David, Robin Furth & Jae Lee
description: The second Marvel Dark Tower graphic novel, following the fall of Gilead and Roland's path onto the trail of the Man in Black.
relation_note: Continues the Gunslinger Born storyline into the ka-tet's early history - same creative team, still not King's own prose.

title: Treachery
creator: Peter David, Robin Furth, Jae Lee & Richard Isanove
description: Third in the Marvel Dark Tower series, covering Roland's early gunslinger training under Cort and Vannay.
relation_note: Part of the same Marvel comics continuity expanding on the core series' backstory.

title: Monsters in the Archives: My Year of Fear with Stephen King
creator: Caroline Bicks
description: A memoir-style reading journey through Stephen King's bibliography over the course of a year.
relation_note: Criticism/memoir about reading King's work, not a King work itself.

title: The Complete Stephen King Universe
creator: Stanley Wiater, Christopher Golden & Hank Wagner
description: A guide mapping the connections between King's novels, stories, and recurring characters and settings.
relation_note: A reference/companion guide written by fans and critics, not King.

title: The Journey Begins
creator: Peter David, Robin Furth, Richard Isanove & Sean Phillips
description: Opens Marvel's comics adaptation of The Gunslinger itself, following Roland's pursuit of the Man in Black across the desert.
relation_note: Adapts the opening of The Gunslinger into comics form - written by Peter David and Robin Furth, not King.

title: The Little Sisters of Eluria
creator: Peter David, Robin Furth, Richard Isanove & Luke Ross
description: Adapts King's novella of the same name, in which Roland is captured by the sinister nursing sisters of Eluria.
relation_note: Comics adaptation of a King novella, scripted by Peter David and Robin Furth.

title: The Battle of Tull
creator: Peter David & Robin Furth
description: Continues the Gunslinger adaptation with Roland's confrontation in the town of Tull.
relation_note: Part of Marvel's Gunslinger comics adaptation, not King's own prose.

title: The Way Station
creator: Peter David, Robin Furth, Richard Isanove & Laurence Campbell
description: Concludes the Gunslinger comics adaptation as Roland reaches the way station and meets Jake Chambers.
relation_note: Final chapter of Marvel's Gunslinger adaptation arc.

title: Fall of Gilead
creator: Peter David, Robin Furth & Jae Lee
description: Fourth Marvel Dark Tower graphic novel, depicting Gilead's descent into chaos and betrayal.
relation_note: Continues the Beginnings storyline - Marvel comics continuity, not King's own prose.

title: The Battle of Jericho Hill
creator: Peter David, Robin Furth & Jae Lee
description: Fifth Marvel Dark Tower graphic novel, covering the climactic battle that ends the ka-tet of Gilead's origin story.
relation_note: Concludes the Beginnings storyline - Marvel comics continuity, not King's own prose.

title: The Man in Black
creator: Peter David, Robin Furth & Jae Lee
description: A one-shot Marvel Dark Tower comic focused on Walter/Marten, the Man in Black.
relation_note: Standalone Marvel comics one-shot expanding the Man in Black's backstory.

title: Last Shots
creator: Peter David, Robin Furth, Richard Isanove & Sean Phillips
description: Concludes Marvel's Gunslinger comics adaptation, collecting three shorter tales: Sheemie's Tale, Evil Ground, and So Fell Lord Perth.
relation_note: Final chapter of Marvel's Gunslinger comics adaptation - Marvel comics continuity, not King's own prose.

title: The Prisoner
creator: Peter David, Robin Furth & Piotr Kowalski
description: Opens Marvel's comics adaptation of The Drawing of the Three, as Roland encounters Eddie Dean, a heroin smuggler drawn through the first of the three doors.
relation_note: Comics adaptation of the opening of The Drawing of the Three, scripted by Peter David and Robin Furth.

title: House of Cards
creator: Peter David & Robin Furth
description: Continues Marvel's comics adaptation of The Drawing of the Three, following Eddie Dean's story after he is drawn through the first door.
relation_note: Comics adaptation of The Drawing of the Three, scripted by Peter David and Robin Furth.

title: The Lady of Shadows
creator: Peter David & Robin Furth
description: Continues the Drawing of the Three adaptation as Roland draws Odetta/Detta through the second door.
relation_note: Part of Marvel's Drawing of the Three comics adaptation.

title: Bitter Medicine
creator: Peter David & Robin Furth
description: Concludes the Drawing of the Three comics adaptation.
relation_note: Final chapter of Marvel's Drawing of the Three adaptation.

title: Stephen King's The Dark Tower: Beginnings
creator: Peter David, Robin Furth & Jae Lee
description: Omnibus collecting the five graphic novels dramatizing young Roland's origin story: The Gunslinger Born, Long Road Home, Treachery, Fall of Gilead, and The Battle of Jericho Hill.
relation_note: Collects Marvel's origin-story Dark Tower comics into one volume - not King's own prose.

title: Stephen King's The Dark Tower: The Gunslinger
creator: Peter David, Robin Furth & Jae Lee
description: Omnibus collecting Marvel's comics adaptation of The Gunslinger: The Journey Begins, The Little Sisters of Eluria, The Battle of Tull, The Way Station, The Man in Black, and Last Shots.
relation_note: Collects the Marvel comics adaptation of King's first Dark Tower novel - not King's own prose.

title: Stephen King's The Dark Tower: The Drawing of the Three
creator: Peter David & Robin Furth
description: Omnibus collecting Marvel's comics adaptation of The Drawing of the Three: The Prisoner, House of Cards, The Lady of Shadows, and Bitter Medicine.
relation_note: Collects the Marvel comics adaptation of King's second Dark Tower novel - not King's own prose.

title: Stephen King's The Dark Tower: The Complete Concordance
creator: Robin Furth
description: An exhaustive reference guide to the characters, places, and lore of the Dark Tower series, compiled from Robin Furth's research notes for King.
relation_note: Written by King's longtime research assistant as a companion reference, not part of the series itself.

title: The Stand: Captain Trips
creator: Roberto Aguirre-Sacasa, Mike Perkins & Laura Martin
description: Opens Marvel's six-volume adaptation of The Stand as the Captain Trips superflu escapes a military base and begins to spread across America.
relation_note: Marvel comics adaptation of King's novel The Stand - scripted by Roberto Aguirre-Sacasa with King as consulting creative force, not King's own prose.

title: The Stand: American Nightmares
creator: Roberto Aguirre-Sacasa, Mike Perkins & Laura Martin
description: Second volume of Marvel's The Stand adaptation, following the survivors of the plague as the dreams of Mother Abagail and the Dark Man begin.
relation_note: Marvel comics adaptation of King's novel The Stand - scripted by Roberto Aguirre-Sacasa with King as consulting creative force, not King's own prose.

title: The Stand: Soul Survivors
creator: Roberto Aguirre-Sacasa, Mike Perkins & Laura Martin
description: Third volume of Marvel's The Stand adaptation, in which Nick Andros and Tom Cullen travel across Nebraska and meet the dangerous Julie Lawry.
relation_note: Marvel comics adaptation of King's novel The Stand - scripted by Roberto Aguirre-Sacasa with King as consulting creative force, not King's own prose.

title: The Stand: Hardcases
creator: Roberto Aguirre-Sacasa, Mike Perkins & Laura Martin
description: Fourth volume of Marvel's The Stand adaptation, as the survivors gather in Boulder and Randall Flagg gathers his followers in Las Vegas.
relation_note: Marvel comics adaptation of King's novel The Stand - scripted by Roberto Aguirre-Sacasa with King as consulting creative force, not King's own prose.

title: The Stand: No Man's Land
creator: Roberto Aguirre-Sacasa, Mike Perkins & Laura Martin
description: Fifth volume of Marvel's The Stand adaptation, as the Boulder Free Zone Committee sends spies west and the two camps move toward confrontation.
relation_note: Marvel comics adaptation of King's novel The Stand - scripted by Roberto Aguirre-Sacasa with King as consulting creative force, not King's own prose.

title: The Stand: The Night Has Come
creator: Roberto Aguirre-Sacasa, Mike Perkins & Laura Martin
description: Final volume of Marvel's The Stand adaptation, covering the march on Las Vegas and the climactic confrontation with Randall Flagg.
relation_note: Marvel comics adaptation of King's novel The Stand - scripted by Roberto Aguirre-Sacasa with King as consulting creative force, not King's own prose.

title: The Stand Omnibus
creator: Roberto Aguirre-Sacasa, Mike Perkins & Laura Martin
description: Two-volume slipcased hardcover collecting the full Marvel adaptation of The Stand: Captain Trips, American Nightmares, Soul Survivors, Hardcases, No Man's Land, and The Night Has Come.
relation_note: Collects Marvel's six-volume comics adaptation of King's novel The Stand into one set - not King's own prose.

title: Stephen King's N.
creator: Marc Guggenheim & Alex Maleev
description: Four-issue Marvel comic series adapting King's short story "N.", in which a psychiatrist's patient describes an obsessive-compulsive ritual that may be holding back something monstrous.
relation_note: Comics adaptation of the short story "N." from Just After Sunset, scripted by Marc Guggenheim - not King's own prose.

title: Creepshow (Comic Adaptation)
creator: Stephen King & Bernie Wrightson
description: The comic book adaptation of the 1982 George A. Romero film, illustrated by Bernie Wrightson and presenting the film's five tales in the style of the classic EC horror comics.
relation_note: Comics version of the Creepshow screenplay King wrote for Romero's film - a tie-in to the movie, not a prose work.

title: Road Rage
creator: Chris Ryall, Nelson Daniel, Stephen King & Joe Hill
description: IDW graphic novel adapting "Throttle", the King and Joe Hill novella of a biker gang stalked by a driverless truck, alongside a comics adaptation of Richard Matheson's "Duel".
relation_note: Comics adaptation of the novella "Throttle" (from the anthology He Is Legend), co-written by King and Joe Hill - adapted to comics by others, not King's own prose.

title: The Road to the Dark Tower: Exploring Stephen King's Magnum Opus
creator: Bev Vincent
description: A companion guide to the Dark Tower series, covering the history of its writing, its influences, and the connections between the books and the rest of King's work.
relation_note: Written by King scholar Bev Vincent as a reference to the Dark Tower series, not part of the series itself.

title: The Stephen King Companion: Four Decades of Fear
creator: George Beahm
description: An illustrated overview of King's life and career, with chapters on his major works, the film adaptations, and his influences.
relation_note: Biography and career guide by King reference author George Beahm, not King himself. This is the 2015 "Four Decades of Fear" edition of a book first published in 1989.

title: Stephen King: Uncollected, Unpublished
creator: Rocky Wood
description: A bibliographic guide to King's rarest material: his uncollected short fiction, unpublished manuscripts, and other pieces that never appeared in his main collections.
relation_note: Reference guide to King's rare and unpublished writing by researcher Rocky Wood, not King himself.

title: The End of the World As We Know It: New Tales of Stephen King's The Stand
creator: Christopher Golden & Brian Keene (eds.)
description: Anthology of new stories set in the world of The Stand, written by dozens of contemporary horror authors, with an introduction by Stephen King.
relation_note: Authorized anthology of new fiction set in King's The Stand universe - written by other authors, with only an introduction from King.

title: Gwendy's Magic Feather
creator: Richard Chizmar
description: Sequel to Gwendy's Button Box: years after the button box vanished, Gwendy Peterson is a successful writer and congresswoman haunted by a missing girl and the return of the box's strange influence.
relation_note: Written by Richard Chizmar alone as the middle book of the Gwendy trilogy, with a foreword by King - the first Castle Rock novel written by another author.
